Rotary Friendship Exchange 2026–27

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown, District 3141, India

Sister Club Agreement with Rotary Club Villa del Parque, District 4895, Argentina 🇮🇳🤝🇦🇷

Building International Friendships • Strengthening Rotary Bonds • Creating Lasting Impact

In a significant step towards strengthening international Rotary relations, the Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown, District 3141, India, and the Rotary Club of Villa del Parque, District 4895, Argentina, formalised a Sister Club Agreement to promote friendship, mutual understanding and cooperation between the two clubs.

The agreement was signed by Rtn. Lalit Sukhani, President of Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown, and Rtn. Ana Maria Smichovski, President of Rotary Club Villa del Parque, Argentina.

A Commitment to International Understanding

The Sister Club Agreement reflects the shared commitment of both clubs to advance Rotary's ideals of service, goodwill and international understanding. It aims to foster friendly relations between members and contribute to stronger ties between the people of India and Argentina.

Through this partnership, both clubs seek to build a lasting relationship founded on fellowship, professional exchange, cooperation and a shared commitment to service.

Key Objectives of the Agreement

The Memorandum of Agreement establishes a framework for continued collaboration between the two clubs through:

Exchange of Information: Regular sharing of membership directories, club publications and newsletters.
Sharing of Service Activities: Keeping members informed about each club's projects, initiatives and achievements.
International Fellowship: Encouraging interaction and friendship among Rotarians from both countries.
Mutual Understanding: Promoting cultural exchange, goodwill and stronger international relations.
Long-Term Partnership: Establishing a continuing relationship, with the agreement intended to remain in force in perpetuity.

From Friendship to Lasting Partnership

The Sister Club Agreement represents more than a formal understanding between two Rotary clubs. It is a commitment to nurturing meaningful relationships, exchanging ideas and exploring opportunities for collaborative service across geographical boundaries.

The partnership, strengthened through the Rotary Friendship Exchange, opens new avenues for members to understand each other's cultures, share experiences and work together towards common humanitarian goals.

By joining hands across continents, Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown and Rotary Club Villa del Parque reaffirm the belief that friendship is the foundation of international understanding and service is the bridge that connects communities.

🇮🇳🤝🇦🇷 Two Clubs • Two Countries • One Rotary Family

This Sister Club Agreement marks an important milestone in the journey towards stronger international fellowship, shared learning and sustainable cooperation.

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown looks forward to nurturing this enduring relationship with Rotary Club Villa del Parque, Argentina, translating friendship into meaningful collaboration and lasting community impact.
